verdict.rationale: Self-hosting under an open-source license is a fair question for a design platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes a proprietary Mac app plus a vendor-hosted web Workspace. Nothing shows a self-hostable deployment or an open-source license for the platform. The GitHub sketch-document repo documents the file format, and the local-only MCP server is an AI integration, so neither counts as self-hosting the platform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
